        shared = None

root = ET.fromstring(wb_xml)

    sroot = ET.fromstring(shared)
    for si in sroot.findall("main:si", NS):
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
        shared_strings.append(text)
print("Shared strings:", shared_strings)

sroot = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml)
rows = []
for row in sroot.findall(".//main:sheetData/main:row", NS):
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall("main:c", NS):
        ref = c.get("r")
        t = c.get("t", "n")
        v = c.find("main:v", NS)
        is_el = c.find("main:is", NS)
        if t == "inlineStr" and is_el is not None:
            val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_el.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
        elif t == "s" and v is not None:
            val = shared_strings[int(v.text)]
        elif v is not None:
            val = v.text
        else:
            val = None
        cells.append((ref, t, val))
    rows.append(cells)

print("\n--- Sheet data ---")
for r in rows:
    print(r)

import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None)

grand_total = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")
    print(df.to_string())
    print()
    numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
    if numeric.empty:
        print(f"No numeric data on sheet '{name}'")
        continue
    col_sums = numeric.sum(numeric_only=True)
    print("Column sums:", col_sums.to_dict())
    sheet_total = col_sums.sum()
    print(f"Sheet total: {sheet_total}")
    grand_total += sheet_total
    print()

print(f"GRAND TOTAL ACROSS ALL SHEETS: {grand_total}")
